label: Fairy Tale
context_hint: Warm, timeless, storybook-illustration tone — as if narrated aloud to a child. Soft, rounded shapes, gentle diffused lighting, whimsical detail (talking creatures, enchanted forests, cozy cottages). Central, simple compositions that read clearly at a glance. Palette is warm and inviting, never harsh or grim. Everything feels safe, magical, and a little nostalgic.
